text:
Sam (recruiter): Heads-up: offer for Ramon (Sr. Infra). Candidate requests 2026-07-01 start, relocating from Spain. Manager asks for $5k sign-on, provisional +3.5% uplift to base, and benefits active on day 1. Can we route an exception?
Priya (people-ops): Please paste a 1-line summary of asks + business reason and deadline for docs.
Sam (recruiter): Summary: sign-on $5k (one-time); provisional uplift +3.5% (above auto 3%); day-1 benefits. Rationale: counteroffer from competitor, critical infra hire, expected impact to project timeline if delayed. Candidate can provide passport + EU address by 2026-06-20.
Marcus (hiring manager): Confirming business impact: if we lose this hire we delay rollout by 8 weeks. Manager approves sign-on from hiring discretionary.
Elaine (comp): +3.5% needs comp sign-off (policy: <=3% auto, 3-7% comp review). Upload manager justification and budget owner approval.
Mike (finance): Finance needs GL code and headcount confirmation. One-time sign-on can be charged to hiring budget. If uplift is approved, run-rate impact must be recorded. GL 5012 OK?
Sam (recruiter): GL = 5012, headcount open. Uploading manager memo now.
Anna (legal): For day-1 benefits we need to add clause re: carrier rules and potential retro premiums. I can add short language to offer if People Ops approves.
Chandra (onboarding): Logistics note: benefits enrollment feed requires 72h. For international relocation we need ID + address confirmation before feed; otherwise effective date may be delayed.
BenefitsBot: Reminder: benefits feed cutoff = 2026-06-28 for 2026-07-01 starts. Escalate to benefits-team if docs missing.
Priya (people-ops): Proposed routing: Manager -> Comp (Elaine) -> Finance (Mike) -> People Ops final. Legal & Onboarding looped. Target decision by 2026-06-24.
Elaine (comp): I'll review manager memo; if justification strong I'll sign-off on +3.5% after finance confirms run-rate. No comp committee needed for <=7%.
Mike (finance): Provisional finance ok pending headcount tracking. Recording conditional approval.
Anna (legal): Draft clause: "Benefits eligibility and enrollment will commence on the employee's start date, subject to carrier rules and timely verification of required documents. Retroactive coverage may be subject to carrier approval."
Chandra (onboarding): I'll queue benefits-team for expedited feed once docs arrive. Need passport + address by 2026-06-20.
Sam (recruiter): Candidate aims to provide docs by 2026-06-18. Thanks all.
Priya (people-ops): Next steps checklist: 1) Sam attach manager memo (done) 2) Elaine comp sign-off 3) Mike finance confirm headcount in tracker 4) Anna update offer template 5) Chandra confirm feed readiness. Target approvals by 2026-06-24.
Elaine (comp): Note: posted comp sign-off pending final scan of memo.
Mike (finance): Marked provisional approval in finance tracker.
Anna (legal): Will update offer language and share link here when ready.
Chandra (onboarding): Onboarding queued. Will notify benefits-team after doc upload.
Sam (recruiter): bump 7: manager memo uploaded and candidate doc ETA confirmed. Tagging @Priya.
Priya (people-ops): Reviewing now. Will update thread by EOD 2026-06-21 with final decision or questions.
Sam (recruiter): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
